scope: Independent reconciliation of every stored 2025 and 2026 regular exterior-color union for the 18 current Chevrolet nameplates against exact GM Online Order Guide vehicle records.
publication_rule: A matching color-name union is not verified complete until exact order codes, WA or manufacturer paint identities, trim restrictions, extra-cost states, build-out or late-availability states, and applicable SEO programs have been normalized from a retained and reviewed source artifact.

sources.title: GM Online Order Guide
sources.limitation: The application API is mutable. An observed response documents a research result but is not permanent evidence unless the exact response or generated PDF is retained, hashed, and reviewed.

retained_snapshot_release.scope: Exact retained 2025 and 2026 generated-PDF snapshots for the specialty, Woodland Green, and exact palette-completion page-review queues. This release is a subset of the 50 live vehicle IDs in the complete reconciliation.
retained_snapshot_release.publication_limit: Retention and page location do not by themselves establish a complete model-year palette or authorize a normalized color row.

specialty_findings.program_scope: Tahoe Retail and Fleet plus combined Police Package and Special Service Order Guide entries
specialty_findings.qualification: All three Retail and Fleet rows are published per year. The six police and special-service rows are published only for the combined entry; no PPV-only or SSV-only applicability is inferred.
specialty_findings.finding: Each Retail and Fleet page publishes Victory Red 5T4 / WA-9260, Woodland Green 9V5 / WA-9015, and Wheatland Yellow 9W3 / WA-253A. Each combined Police Package and Special Service page publishes six rows. Interior applicability, the five-order minimum, and the combined-program boundary remain exact.

Both retained police-package tables print Victory Red 5T4 / WA-9260, MSP Goose Blue 9V2 / WA-5665, Dark Blue Metallic 9V7 / WA-722J, and Silver Ice Metallic 9W5 / WA-636R. In 2025, Victory Red carries a planned-Q1-2025 note, and the other three rows are footnoted not available at the reviewed revision despite their A cells. The 2026 page has no row-specific unavailability footnotes.
specialty_findings.program_scope: Blazer EV Police Package 9C1 and 9C3 Order Guide entries
specialty_findings.qualification: The exact four-row SEO table is published for 9C1 and 9C3 only. The 2025 A cells and controlling row footnotes are both preserved; no 5W4 applicability is inferred from these pages.

specialty_findings.finding: The archive has four standard and 21 SEO rows for each program, but two official-source literal conflicts require page-level re-review.

specialty_findings.program_scope: Colorado WT SEO Paint Order Guide entries
specialty_findings.qualification: Every row is limited to Colorado WT for its printed model year. Literal none code cells are normalized to null while the exact source literal remains recorded.
specialty_findings.finding: The 2025 table publishes seventeen A rows and the 2026 table publishes fourteen A rows. Both require five orders before plant submission. The archive keeps each repeated Yellow label separate by WA identity and does not apply the interior-only PCU footnote to paint availability.

specialty_findings.program_scope: Express Cargo, Cutaway, and Passenger SEO Solid Paint Order Guide entries
specialty_findings.qualification: All eighteen printed rows are published independently for Cargo, Cutaway, and Passenger in each model year; duplicate labels are not collapsed across configurations or WA identities.
specialty_findings.finding: The six pages produce 108 exact configuration-color records. Every row preserves its interior columns, five-order minimum, and flat-Black extraneous-body-component rule.

specialty_findings.program_scope: Silverado 2500 HD Retail and Fleet, 3500 HD CC, 3500 HD Retail and Fleet, and 4500/5500/6500 HD SEO Paint Order Guide entries
specialty_findings.qualification: All source rows are published separately by configuration and year. Literal none light-HD code cells, medium-duty codes, interior applicability, and unbound numbered notes remain source-scoped.
specialty_findings.finding: The eight pages produce 186 exact configuration-color records, 93 per year, representing 48 distinct source identities per year. The 5IS / WA-636R versus 5IS / WA-363R conflict and all three WA-722J variants remain explicit.

identity_guards: Current GM Order Guide records directly support Woodland Green for exact 2025 and 2026 Chevrolet applications, usually as 9V5 / WA-9015.
Low Cab Forward Woodland Green uses Isuzu code 46U with no WA number and must remain a separate identity.
Forest Service Green, Federal Standard 595 No. 14260, and USDA identifier 5032 remain unresolved research leads with no established Chevrolet model-year or GM paint code.
Forest Service Green must not be merged with Woodland Green, Green WA-7927, Forest Green Metallic, or another similarly named Chevrolet color.
